title: Get Apps
description: Returns a list of apps from My Apps in Orchestrate.

query.name: q
query.description: Pass a value for q to search for apps matching the query string.

query.name: ordering
query.description: Use `ordering=title` to sort by title or `ordering=modified_at` to sort by the last update date. Add `-` before the parameter to sort in descending order.

query.name: page
query.description: Pass the page number to retrieve the apps list.

query.name: page_size
query.description: Pass the number of items to retrieve per page.

query.name: created_by
query.description: Pass the user ID to retrieve a list of the apps created by a user.

query.name: app_type
query.description: Pass `READY_TO_USE` to list active apps, `IN_PROGRESS` to list the inactive apps, and `INSTALLED` to retrieve apps that are installed.

query.name: categories
query.description: Pass the categories to filter apps.

query.name: is_system
query.description: Pass false to retrieve custom apps or true to retrieve apps.

query.name: is_configured
query.description: Pass true to get configured apps or false to get non-configured apps.

query.name: lite_enabled
query.description: Pass true to retrieve agent-compatible apps or false to fetch apps that are not agent-compatible.

query.name: created_at
query.description: Pass the `created_at` value to filter apps created in the last week, month, or year.

query.name: created_at__gte
query.description: Pass the start time in Unix time format. The list of apps created after the entered time will be returned. Example: *1655145000*.

query.name: created_at__lte
query.description: Pass the end time in Unix time format. The list of apps created before the entered time will be returned. Example: *1642530599*.

body.name: results
body.description: Returns details of apps. Each object provides the details of one app.

items.name: unique_id
items.description: Returns the dynamically generated unique ID of the app. For example, *7d0bfe45-23e3-4842-a6c2-18df18ca37d1*.

items.name: title
items.description: Returns the title of the app.

items.name: description

items.value: The app provides helpful actions to automate small tasks.
